title: The Radan Protocol — Live Case Board (CHEM 1A Murder Mystery)
author: Rob Gilley
description: A semester-long forensic murder mystery running live in CHEM 1A, Fall 26. This is the class's case board — every piece of evidence appears here after it's revealed in class, all semester. Check in weekly and watch the case grow. Warning: the rabbit hole is deep, and it's bingeable.
